originalReview.notes: The original EPA aerial shows the linked lakefront industrial ranges, stepped light-sided sheds, large stack group, tanks and elevated conveyor work. It supports form and materials as historical evidence.

quallaSearch.notes: Exact EPA DOCUMERICA photograph NARA 555165 matches the Qualla hero. The other public-domain image shows timber and a worker and does not document exterior architecture. Attribution-conditioned and other secondary imagery was excluded. The historical stack group dates to the original process, while the permit and the regional history distinguish subsequent operations.
